'''Günter E. W. Schmidt''' (born 10 May 1926 in [[Lübeck]]; died 23 December 2016 in [[Deutsch Evern]])<ref name=obit>{{citation |url=http://www.trauer-lüneburg.de/Traueranzeige/Guenter-Schmidt |title=Traueranzeige Günter Schmidt |work=Lüneburger Landeszeitung |date=2016-12-24 |language=de |access-date=2017-03-17}}</ref> was a German [[arachnologist]] and author of a standard German work on [[tarantula]]s, ''Die Vogelspinnen'' ("bird-eating spiders"). He has been described as one of the fathers of German arachnology.<ref name=Pete06>{{Citation |last1=Peters |first1=H.-J. |date=2006 |title=Dr. Günter Schmidt – der älteste noch immer aktive Spinnenforscher der Alten Welt |journal=Tarantulas of the World |volume=11 |issue=117 |issn=1431-7990 |language=de }}</ref>

He studied biology and mostly worked in the pharmaceutical industry until his retirement.<ref name=":0">[http://spinnen-schmidt.de/de/nachruf.htm Obituary] for Günther Schmidt by John Osmani</ref> In 1975, he graduated with a PhD thesis on the arachnid fauna of the Canary Islands.<ref name=":0" /> From 1986, his scientific work was concentrated mainly on tarantulas. The [[World Spider Catalog]] lists 234 species names of which he is the author or co-author (not all currently accepted),<ref name=WSC_s1>{{citation |title=Search for author 'Schmidt' |work=World Spider Catalog |publisher=Natural History Museum Bern |url=https://wsc.nmbe.ch/search?sFamily=&fMt=begin&sGenus=&gMt=begin&sSpecies=&sMt=begin&multiPurpose=sAuthor&sMulti=Schmidt&mMt=contain&searchSpec=s |access-date=2021-04-21 }}</ref> of which 69 are in the family Theraphosidae ([[tarantula]]s).<ref name=WSC_s2>{{citation |title=Search for family 'Theraphosidae' and author 'Schmidt' |work=World Spider Catalog |publisher=Natural History Museum Bern |url=https://wsc.nmbe.ch/search?sFamily=Theraphosidae&fMt=begin&sGenus=&gMt=begin&sSpecies=&sMt=begin&multiPurpose=sAuthor&sMulti=Schmidt&mMt=contain&searchSpec=s |access-date=2021-04-21 }}</ref>

==Books==
His books include:
*{{Citation |last1=Schmidt |first1=Günter |date=1986 |title=Vogelspinnen : Lebensweise, Bestimmungsschlüssel, Haltung und Zucht |publication-place=Minden |publisher=A. Philler |isbn=978-3-7907-5001-0 }}; followed by further editions, including {{Citation |last1=Schmidt |first1=Günter |date=1993 |title=Vogelspinnen : Vorkommen, Lebensweise, Haltung und Zucht, mit Bestimmungsschlüsseln für alle Gattungen |publication-place=Hannover |publisher=Landbuch |isbn=978-3-7842-0484-0 }}
*{{Citation |last1=Schmidt |first1=Günter |date=2000 |title=Giftige und gefährliche Spinnentiere |publisher=Westarp Wissenschaften |isbn=978-3-89432-405-6 }}
*{{Citation |last1=Schmidt |first1=G. |date=2003 |title=Die Vogelspinnen: Eine weltweite Übersicht |publication-place=Hohenwarsleben |publisher=Westarp Wissenschaften |isbn=978-3-89432-899-3 |series=Neue Brehm-Bücherei }}

==Species names==
Several species names of spiders honour Günter Schmidt, including:
* ''Haplopelma schmidti'' <small>von Wirth, 1991</small><ref name=Wirt91>{{Citation |last1=von Wirth |first1=V. |date=1991 |title=Eine neue Vogelspinnenart aus Vietnam ''Haplopelma schmidti'' sp. n. (Araneae: Theraphosidae: Ornithoctoninae) |journal=Arachnologischer Anzeiger |volume=18 |pages=6–11 }}</ref> (now ''[[Cyriopagopus schmidti]]'')
* ''Aphonopelma schmidti'' <small>Smith, 1995</small><ref name=Smit95>{{Citation |last=Smith |first=Andrew M. |date=1995 |title=Tarantula Spiders: Tarantulas of the U.S.A. and Mexico |publisher=Fitzgerald Publishing |location=London |ISBN=0951093991 }}</ref> (now a [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]] of ''[[Aphonopelma chalcodes]]'')
* ''[[Cyrtopholis schmidti]]'' <small>Rudloff, 1996</small><ref name=Rudl96>{{Citation |last1=Rudloff |first1=J.-P. |date=1996 |title=''Cyrtopholis schmidti'' sp. n., eine neue ''Cyrtopholis''-Art aus Brasilien (Araneida: Theraphosidae: Theraphosinae) |journal=Arachnologisches Magazin |volume=4 |issue=5 |pages=2–8 }}</ref>
